figures.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a publication-quality scientific framework figure for a top-tier machine learning paper, landscape about 16:9, high-resolution white background, crisp flat vector-style lines and clean readable sans-serif typography. Title "EvoTrace". Muted teal for retained algorithms, light gray for removed implementations, warm orange for experience, blue for generation. Ample white space, restrained academic aesthetic, no decorative artwork, no shadows, no marketing slogans.

The message: one tree-structured population jointly maintains executable candidates and accumulated design experience. Dynamic reflective simplification updates this tree; sampling and operator views use the resulting tree to generate a new evaluated algorithm.

Three panels arranged left to right, with clearly separated titles:
(a) "Grow the population"
(b) "Reflective simplification"
(c) "Continue search"

Panel a: draw a primary-parent tree EXACTLY with root r -> A; A -> B -> C -> D; B -> X; A -> Y; A -> E; E -> P and E -> R. Draw r as a small unfilled square. A,D,E,P,R teal filled circles. B,C,X,Y gray circles. Draw a subtle translucent orange enclosure around B,C,X, clearly enclosing the side attempt X as part of the same removed region. A separate small enclosure around Y. No node IDs repeated. Under tree two short lines "Quality representatives + recent algorithms" and "Preserve necessary forks".

A slim arrow goes from panel a to b, labelled "Retain, summarize, reconnect".
Panel b: exact retained tree r -> A; A -> D; A -> E; E -> P; E -> R. Put an orange outlined tag "V_AD" ON edge A->D. Put an orange outlined tag "S_A" beside A. Beneath, two simple stacked orange annotations: "B, C, X -> V_AD" and "Y -> S_A". Use a tiny legend "V: path experience" and "S: branch experience". The key invariant: X is attached to removed B and belongs to V_AD, NOT S_A. Y belongs to S_A. Keep primary-parent edges distinct from information-flow arrows.

Panel c: top small block "Select a parent" with subline "Quality + development count". Under it three compact parallel labels "Refine", "Crossover", "Explore", with subline respectively "Local development", "Two development paths", "Route ideas + experience". These feed a single box "Generate & evaluate". A blue output node N beside it is labelled "Evaluated candidate". A large clean blue return arrow from this output goes along bottom back to panel a, labelled "Add to the primary-parent tree". Show a short illustrative P -> N primary-parent relation near output, with N blue. Reference R is ONLY an information input into Crossover; do not draw R as a second parent of N. No other duplicate cyclic tree edges.

Short caption INSIDE bottom margin: "Candidate updates and experience accumulation on the same tree".
Accuracy: no numerical results, no fixed population capacity, no hard route cap, no independent champion in reflection, no statements about proven performance. Typography short and legible; do not add dense paragraphs or equations beyond the two experience mappings.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create a publication-quality scientific method diagram for a top-tier machine learning paper. High-resolution wide landscape ~16:9, white background, flat vector-style precise geometry, crisp readable sans-serif labels, restrained teal/gray/orange palette matching an academic methods figure. Title "Dynamic reflective simplification". Three panels side by side.

(a) "One retained set". Show EXACT tree: A -> B -> C -> D in a horizontal row; B -> X downwards; A -> Y downwards. Retained nodes A,D are teal filled circles; removed B,C,X,Y are light gray circles. A has small orange outlined "old S_A" attached; B has "old S_B". Thin dark directed arrows for the tree. Put a pale orange dashed enclosure around B,C,X ONLY. Label that enclosure "Path region". A separate pale pale yellow small enclosure around Y label "Side region". A,D outside enclosures. Make B->X visible inside path region, and A->Y visible to side region. This diagram must clearly make X a side attempt of the contracted intermediate B.

(b) "Reflect each region". Two aligned evidence blocks.
Upper orange outline block: title "Path reflection"; exact contents, on three lines: "A -> D: endpoint comparison", "B, C and side attempt X", "Prior path experience + old S_B". Output arrow toward V_AD in panel c.
Lower orange outline block: title "Branch reflection"; exact contents: "A -> Y: actual-parent comparison", "Prior branch experience + old S_A". Output arrow toward S_A in panel c.
Small text below blocks: "Code changes + measured outcomes -> design experience".
Small neutral note "Each removed node belongs to one region".

(c) "Reconnect and continue". Retained teal A -> D horizontal edge; place orange outlined V_AD tag at center on this edge. Orange outlined S_A tag attached to node A. Mapping text directly below: "B, C, X -> V_AD" and "Y -> S_A". At bottom right small neutral box "Read experience in subsequent design" receiving dotted orange information arrows from V_AD and S_A. No extra parent nodes or extra algorithm edges.

Legend at bottom left: teal filled circle "retained implementation", gray circle "removed implementation", orange outline "condensed experience". Crucial invariant: X joins B and C in the PATH reflection and edge V_AD, never node S_A. Existing old S_B travels with B into V_AD; old S_A remains at A and merges with Y. A to D represents development, not guaranteed improvement. Do not write the word improvement, do not invent scores. No 3D, gradients, decorative icons, prose paragraphs, or additional nodes. Make all arrow origins/targets unambiguous and preserve reading order.

framework_revisions:
Edit this scientific framework figure, preserving its three-panel layout, all node identities, all primary-parent tree edges, readable typography and restrained palette. Make two precise semantic corrections.
1. In panel (a), shrink the pale orange enclosure to contain ONLY gray B,C,X. The teal retained D must be completely OUTSIDE the orange region. Alternatively remove this enclosure if it cannot cleanly exclude D. Keep Y in its separate small region.
2. Show information transfer from the maintained tree in panel (b) into search in panel (c). The tree must visibly provide both selectable programs and orange node/edge experience to generation. Add one clean teal connector from retained tree toward "Select a parent", and one clean orange dashed connector starting at the V_AD/S_A experience area, labelled "Experience", ending at the operator-context row (Refine / Crossover / Explore). Widen the whitespace between panels if needed to route these clearly. The existing R-to-Crossover reference input must use BLUE dashed styling, labelled "Reference", rather than orange, so it cannot be mistaken for experience. Tree edges remain dark solid. No information connector is a structural parent edge.
Do not change mappings B,C,X -> V_AD and Y -> S_A. Do not invent nodes, scores or performance claims. Keep N with only P as its structural parent. Make the result clean, publication-ready, and legible at double-column width.

Edit only the ORANGE dashed "Experience" connector in this figure. It currently incorrectly starts at node R. Completely remove that orange connector from R. Instead, start the orange dashed Experience arrow at the orange S_A tag near node A in panel (b), route it cleanly rightward across the panel gap, and terminate it on the shared horizontal distributor ABOVE the three operator boxes in panel (c). Add the small neutral label "Task-specific context" to that distributor if space permits. This shared distributor then feeds Refine, Crossover, Explore. R should have ONLY its blue dashed Reference arrow. Keep the teal Programs arrow, the blue Reference arrow, all structural tree edges, all nodes, exact experience mappings, colors, text and overall composition unchanged. Do not add any other arrows or change node positions. Ensure the experience flow originates from an EXPERIENCE TAG, NOT from an implementation node.
